Meeting records Transcript 
Summary
Noémi Biró, Koda, and Unbody io met to discuss upcoming work, noting Koda's physiotherapy progress and that Gabber would be absent. They decided to review the security documents, which Melissa had shared, individually and sync later via Discord, while Noémi Biró committed to pulling the website to fix two issues. The participants confirmed a meeting with Melissa tomorrow at 9:30 AM to focus on brainstorming module design for the beta phase and review materials, which included text based on Dina's writing.
Details
Personal Updates and Attendance: The discussion began with a brief update on Koda's physiotherapy and ongoing recovery, noting they are still using crutches but things are improving. Noémi Biró confirmed that Gabber would not be joining the meeting (00:00:00).
Website and Security Document Review: Noémi Biró planned to pull the website to fix two issues and mentioned a prior discussion about having a meeting regarding security documents shared by Melissa (00:00:00). They initially considered reviewing these documents together but decided to handle the security document review individually first, with Unbody io offering to have a call later that day if needed (00:03:12) (00:05:50).
Scheduling Tomorrow's Meeting with Melissa: Noémi Biró confirmed that Melissa is available tomorrow between 8:30 and 10:30 in the morning (00:03:12). They agreed to meet with Melissa at 9:30 to check in and review the materials (00:05:50).
Purpose of Tomorrow's Meeting: Modules vs. Safety: The main purpose of the meeting with Melissa was clarified as brainstorming for the modules, not primarily discussing the implementation plan (00:03:12). Unbody io expressed concern that the safety documents, while important for future adjustments, should not be a blocker for module design, as it mainly affects the chat functionality. Noémi Biró confirmed that Melissa has provided text based on Dina’s writing and wants input on what to build for the beta phase and what might be acquired off-the-shelf (00:04:38).
Module Input Status: Noémi Biró noted that they already have two sources of input regarding the modules and that Dina’s final document is expected by the end of the week (00:04:38). Melissa was expected to provide more input over the weekend based on their journal, but that information is not yet available (00:05:50).
Individual Review of Security Documents and Sync: The participants decided to review the security documents individually, with the agreement to sync via Discord afterward to determine if a follow-up meeting is necessary. Noémi Biró committed to fixing the website issues, pushing the changes, and informing the team in Discord (00:05:50).
Suggested next steps
Noémi Biró will pull the website, fix the two things, push the fix, and put it in the Discord.
Unbody io and Noémi Biró will have a meeting with Melissa tomorrow morning at 9:30 to discuss brainstorming for the modules.
Unbody io and Noémi Biró will individually read the security documents that Melissa shared, and sync through Discord (having a meeting if necessary).
